name: Sanggam inlay
summary: Lines are cut into leather-hard clay and filled with white or black slip. The glaze then covers the surface, and the pattern shows below it.
how: Cut or stamp the pattern into the leather-hard clay.
Fill the lines with white or dark slip.

origin.note: Goryeo potters inlay celadon with white and black slip.

adoptions.via: Goryeo potters inlay cranes, clouds and flowers in the green celadon.
Early Joseon potters use the same inlay on grey stoneware under a white slip.
